cohort: 380 women at public health institutions in Debre Markos town, Ethiopia
finding: Person-centered maternity care was low compared with World Health Organization standards, and factors associated with higher scores included commencing antenatal care before the third trimester, vaginal delivery, higher maternal education, being multiparous, and delivering in a health center.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with lower person-centered maternity care scores.
